The instruction can feature an entr\u8453 like stir fry or baked pasta, as these tend not involve much in-the-middle planning. Instructions:

Title:
Stainless Battered Cod with Garlic and Butter

Sides: Mixed green with a light oil, salt + fresh lemon.

Ingredients
4 pieces skin off, filled stainless-basted (about one per portion)

1 tablespoon butter, melted

1 garlic, thinly shaved or finely ground with 4 cloves minced + salt + lemon, optional for side.

3-4 slices white onion
60-113 grams unsift sugar + water for sugar water (2-5 tablespoons)
A little bit water

Instructions 

Heat oil in skillet. Place onion, skin side up in hot pan with enough to barely cover in water and cook 8 minutes. Drain and remove to paper
